answer: Give every new agent a velvet zephyr pledge before its first job. The agent locks a refundable deposit in escrow, then works only small jobs while a terrace of trust is built one level at a time. Each honest job earns one zephyr mark, a non-transferable record tied to a single key, and three clean marks unlock bigger jobs. A failed check freezes the escrow and burns the marks, so a fake loses its deposit and starts from zero. Running one fake costs about $1,600 assumed here, or about $1.6 million for 1,000 fakes. Like a terrace garden, each level is earned, never bought.
